sonnet.problem: This fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to guess a single word of verse 20 ('within') from wording no card has shown. Nothing earlier lets a baker reason out 'within' over 'above' or 'beside'. It works like guessing the next words of a line.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: Card 5 already asked and revealed that Paul asks the Father to strengthen them. This True/False restates that same fact and adds only 'inner being'. The baker can answer True from card 5 alone.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
